 Photo by: Mississippi State Athletics SEC Adjusts Football Kickoff Time As State Hosts Auburn
 November 13, 2026 | Football
 Share: STARKVILLE — The Southeastern Conference has announced an adjusted game start time for Mississippi State's home contest against Auburn on Saturday, November 14.
 The Bulldogs will now kick off at 3:15 p.m. CT against the Tigers at Davis Wade Stadium. The game will be broadcast on SEC Network.  
This game start time change was decided by the SEC as a result of issues related to Friday's FAA ground stoppage.
Davis Wade Stadium gates will open at 1:15 p.m., and the "Dawg Deals" discounted concession pricing on select items will be moved to 1:15-2:45 p.m.
 For the most up-to-date information on the Bulldogs, follow MSU football on X , like them on Facebook and join them on Instagram by searching for " HailStateFB ."
